history.value: HV Capital was founded in Munich in 2000 as Holtzbrinck Ventures, the venture arm of the Georg von Holtzbrinck publishing group, and became an independent partnership in 2010, taking its current name in 2020. It became known for early bets on Zalando, Delivery Hero, HelloFresh, Flix and Scalable Capital. In 2023 it closed its ninth fund at €710 million, split between an early stage and a growth vehicle.
history.basis: founding and the corporate lineage: the firm's own 2007 and 2011 pages (founding_year) and Martin Weber's team page (independence in 2010); the rebrand with Fund VIII in 2020 (Global Venturing, 2020-11-03); the bets named are the firm's own export and 2015 site, all members; Fund IX: 'closed its ninth Fund IX at EUR 710 million ... split into two vehicles, Fund IX Venture and Fund IX Growth' (TechCrunch, 2023-05-04). Left out to fit: the Rocket Internet co-investments (Lazada, Dafiti, lamoda, Linio) and the Rocket share sale of 2014; Groupon via CityDeal; Fund X (Ventures and Growth Form Ds of 2026-01 and 2026-05).

investment_concept.basis: The firm's own statement, verbatim from the homepage h1 ('Backing the bold / Building the future'), read 2026-09-29, set as two sentences with closing periods. Competing lines: the portfolio page's 'HV backs Europe's most ambitious founders from Seed to Growth.' and the homepage's 'The future starts as a bold idea. We provide the capital and conviction to help founders build it.' The title tag is 'HV Capital' and the meta description 'Welcome'.
